title: Boz credential
description: C-15 (2026-09-17): the shapes a second port needs to accept a Boz credential — the label a resident carries, the law's grant record, the three chain rows a verifier reads (institute:graduated, credential:granted, credential:lapsed), and the A2A skills[] entry a port SHOULD publish. The rules in prose: README.md beside this file. The city publishes this schema; the A2A card itself is the registry's.

skill.description: One of the five axes a hire is scored on (Skills, city/src/sim/entities/resident.ts; CREDENTIAL_SKILLS, city/src/sim/systems/hire.ts), in the axis order.

level.description: A whole number >= 1. The Institute writes level = count of same-skill labels + 1, never capped; the law grants up to credentialLevelMax (3); a task may require at most taskLevelMax (2).

tick.description: A world tick: minutes since the world's start, >= 0.

label.description: The credential as the resident carries it and as a hire's terms name it: <skill>:<level>. Resident.credentials is the list of these, contiguous per skill (the law adds max+1 and lapses only the top).

grant.description: One entry of Resident.grants — a level the law granted by three passed signed hires. Append-only; a lapsed grant keeps its row and gains lapsedAt. The view (ResidentView.grants) carries skill, level, at and lapsedAt; hires stays on the resident and on the chain row.

hires.description: The three lowest ids of the passed hires that earned it.

chainRowCommon.description: What every credential row on a personal agent's chain shares: the actor is the resident's personal agent, the row is the law's (by: 'law'), and it names the resident and the label.

instituteGraduated.description: The refs of the chain row subject 'institute:graduated' (city/src/sim/systems/institute.ts): a graduation at the Boz Institute; from/to are the skill axis before and after (0..100), sections the course length.

credentialGranted.description: The refs of the chain row subject 'credential:granted' (city/src/sim/systems/hire.ts, C-10): the law granted level to = from + 1 after three passed signed hires at level from; hires are their ids.

hires.description: The three hire ids, comma-joined: a chain row's refs hold numbers and strings only (city/src/agents/audit.ts), so the list rides as text; Resident.grants[].hires is the same three as integers.

credentialLapsed.description: The refs of the chain row subject 'credential:lapsed' (city/src/sim/systems/hire.ts, C-10): a granted level from lapsed to from - 1 after weeks (8) without a passed signed hire at level >= from - 1; lastPassedAt is the tick of the last such pass. Only granted levels lapse; credential names the label removed.

a2aSkill.description: The skills[] entry a port SHOULD publish on an agent's A2A card for each label its resident holds: id boz:credential:<skill>:<level>, name '<skill> L<level>', tags naming the scheme, the skill, the level and whether the Institute or the law wrote it. The card advertises; a verifier reads the chain rows, never the card.

skills.description: The skill enum, as a list — the engine's CREDENTIAL_SKILLS in order.

x-boz.description: The constants of the law, mirrored here so the schema cannot drift from the engine (tests/credentials.test.ts pins them).
